title: nvPAX: Constrained Optimization for Dynamic Power Allocation in Hierarchical and Multi-Tenant Systems
summary: Power oversubscription is increasingly central to datacenter operation as power density grows, making it necessary to dynamically allocate limited power budgets across devices based on real-time demand. Existing approaches typically assume flat power domains, whereas in practice power distribution is hierarchical and allocation decisions must additionally respect tenant-level contractual constraints.
